identity: Lorindor's berry woods and pearl shore pay their tolls twice: to netters in the woods at night and to mirefolk who count pearls that were never theirs.

quests.title: [PH] Loosen the Snares
quests.text: [PH] Orya Petalward has an answer to the silent birds: make the snares at the {name:snare_ground} in the {name:berrywoods} useless. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Orya Petalward has an answer to the silent birds: make the snares at the {name:snare_ground} in the {name:berrywoods} useless. Real text to follow.
[PH] Lethen Moonledger wants the marked snares at the {name:snare_ground} in the {name:eaves} cut; false forest signs are poor company for an observer. Real text to follow.

quests.lesson: A use at a recipe place in the open: the same act in two woods.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Schlingen lösen' (K9 A): the snare grounds of Lorindor's Berrywoods and Moonfall's Eaves.
